text_block_list.text:
One day, heading to the track with
Loves Only You for training...

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I think so. According to the app, this time slot is reserved for our group.
...See? It's already fully booked, right?
choice_data_list: Y-You're right. There's no name on it...!

text_block_list.text:
Did an oversight happen in the paperwork somewhere?
At this rate, today's entire training schedule will fall apart...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun!
Let's check today's schedule real quick, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-chan.
Let's go over today's schedule real quick, okay?”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If we check it over together,
I'm sure we can think of a great way.
—Come on, let's go♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah—look, Trainer-kun!
Looks like we can use the pool right away if we go now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah—look, Trainer-chan!
Looks like we can use the pool right away if we go now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then if we move up the pool training we planned
and connect it right to the gym workout...
See, wouldn't that be great for cutting down transit time?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, looks like the woodchip track barely has an open slot this evening.
Let's go apply for it right now♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So, how about we do the running training we originally planned if the track is available, and if not, we use the outer perimeter instead?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that seems to fit today's goal well!
Yeah, that fits right in with today's goal!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Well then,
let's roll with that for today♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm glad I could help too.
When in trouble, helping each other with love is what it's all about, right? ♪

"...She says that, but the truth is,
I was completely one-sidedly saved by her.
As a Trainer, it's utterly pathetic."
choice_data_list: Even so... you handled that with incredible skill.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪
Looks like good habits came in handy this time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —When you run a community, you find yourself staring down the schedule an awful lot.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I calculate the number of stream slots from the time I have each day,
plan when to post on social media,
and prep blog updates and new content...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: While you're waiting, equipment might break down, or new errands might pop up—unforeseen things happen all the time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I always run through scenarios in my head, prepared for whatever might happen."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—That way, everyone and I can always
have the most lovely time together, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That's right♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Trainer-kun.
There's something I want you to remember—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Trainer-chan.
There's something I want you to remember—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "The only reason I could help fine-tune things today is because you put together such a solid training plan, Trainer-kun, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "The only reason I could help fine-tune things today is because you put together such a solid training plan, Trainer-chan, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Like how you can't cook without ingredients? Having a shared policy keeps us from hesitating, and having an original plan allows us to rearrange things.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When you look at it that way, see?
We're giving each other lots of mutual-support-love, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go♪
I'm just itching
to get moving already!

—Thanks to Loves Only You, the rest of the training session
ended up being truly meaningful...
—That night.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
“—I see, I see~.
So Loves-chan completely came to the rescue, then.”

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"She's quite a sensible girl, after all.
Well, as the bridge between you two,
I imagine you must feel both happy and frustrated, but..."

"...I was sharing what happened today
with everyone in the committee."

"There is a clear reason for this action.
And that is—"
choice_data_list: "I want to be of more help to her."

text_block_list.text:
I once declared before everyone that I would "bring Loves Only You to the world."
I am acutely aware that this is my duty.

However, what truly matters is for
Loves Only You's dream to come true,
not whether or not I fulfill my role.

Therefore, you must never be fixated on solving everything alone.
You must rely on others. On the comrades who watch over her.
choice_data_list: 'Please, would you lend me your wisdom?'

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
“――Sounds good to me.
I'm more than happy to have you count on me like that.”

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "We feel the same way. We always want to be of help to her, after all."

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Now that that's settled, let's put our heads together right away!
How can 'Bridge' be of even more help to Loves-chan?"

And so, borrowing the wisdom of the comm members,
I received advice on how I could be
of more help to Loves Only You, and—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Is it okay to stream our track training too?

Though time and locations were limited, I managed to
negotiate permission from the academy to stream her
training sessions to her fan community.
By preparing the equipment and filming her myself, I can deliver her presence to the community members in a whole new way. That surely will—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!
So lovely!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, thank you so, so much! It's just soo hard to film yourself running when you're alone...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, thank you so so much!
It's just suuuper tough to take videos
of yourself running all alone...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Plus, filming other girls during training is a no-go, so the bar was super high...
I can't believe you managed to get permission for me~!
choice_data_list: Everyone wants to see you give it your all, too.
Everyone wants to see you give it your all, too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
I really wanted to show it to everyone too!
choice_data_list: Also, I'll explain the training menu.
Also, I'll explain the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! That sounds wonderful!
I feel like everyone would enjoy watching my training even more...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Agh, I can't hold back anymore,
I wanna start streaming already!
Let's get ready, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez, I can't hold back anymore,
I wanna start streaming right now!
Let's get ready, Trainer-chan~!

The ideas to livestream training and explain the drills to viewers
all came from consulting with the community members.

And right now, these are serving as a massive boost
to Loves Only You's motivation...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? When you say 'everyone'—

Since there was no reason to hide it, I revealed to her that the proposal
was an idea born from brainstorming with all the comm members.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —...So that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it,
you really are amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it,
you really are amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: No. It's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you always consider
what's precious to me and what I want to do,
and make it all come true—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Because you always consider the things I hold dear and what I want to do, and you make them come true—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It connects everyone's strength.
I can work hard for that...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's... not something just anyone can do.
I think it's your strength, Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's... not something just anyone can do.
I think it's your strength, Trainer-chan."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"So have more confidence in yourself♪
I'll be counting on you lots from now on too♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Yaah!!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"What power...!" "So cool~"
"Feels so real!" "Do your best!!"
"You're gorgeous, Love-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
I'm not done yet~!!

"...As her Trainer,
I'll join forces with the comm members to support her."

"Watching Loves Only You run so joyfully,
I renewed my resolve once again—"
